title: G-MAD: A Game-Based Data Generation Framework for Multi-View RGB-T Aerial Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2607.19942v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This work introduces G-MAD, an open-source framework that uses Arma3 to generate synchronized multi-view RGB-T data for aerial object detection. G-MAD addresses key limitations of real-world aerial dataset construction, including limited viewpoint control, imperfect RGB-T alignment and high annotation cost. The framework supports structured scenario specification, controllable multi-view camera placement, simultaneous visible/thermal capture, and automatic bounding box annotation using engine-level geometric metadata. These capabilities enable controlled studies of viewpoint variation, multi-modal fusion, and synthetic-to-real transfer in aerial object detection. Besides, using G-MAD, we construct and release AMOD, a new large-scale multi-view aerial RGB-T object detection benchmark. The source code and the dataset are available at https://unique-chan.github.io/G-MAD-Project.

translated_title: G-MAD：一种基于游戏的多视角RGB-T航空目标检测数据生成框架
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了G-MAD，一个开源框架，利用Arma3生成用于航空目标检测的同步多视角RGB-T数据。G-MAD解决了真实航空数据集构建的关键限制，包括有限的视角控制、不完美的RGB-T对齐和高标注成本。该框架支持结构化场景规范、可控多视角相机布置、同时可见光/热成像捕获，以及利用引擎级几何元数据自动生成边界框标注。这些功能使得能够对航空目标检测中的视角变化、多模态融合和合成到真实迁移进行受控研究。此外，使用G-MAD，我们构建并发布了AMOD，一个新的多视角航空RGB-T目标检测基准数据集。源代码和数据集可在https://unique-chan.github.io/G-MAD-Project获取。
tldr: G-MAD通过游戏引擎提供了一种可控、低成本的合成数据生成方法，解决了真实航空数据集的视角限制、对齐问题和标注成本，并推出了大规模基准AMOD。
en_tdlr: G-MAD provides a controllable, low-cost synthetic data generation approach via a game engine, addressing viewpoint limitations, alignment issues, and annotation costs in real aerial datasets, and introduces the large-scale benchmark AMOD.
